notes: Modified cash basis village with audit statements; basis cash. Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement of revenues and expenditures (Total Governmental Funds column, p4); beginning/ending cash are total fund balances 273,176 / 224,911 (p4), which roll forward with receipts, disbursements and transfers. Balance sheet p3 total assets 226,349 differ by 1,438 accrued expenses. Business-type lines from the proprietary statement p6 (Total column); loan fee and interest expense are shown under nonoperating and included in disbursements; depreciation included. The proprietary cash flow statement (p7) is not recorded in proprietary since the basis is cash. Balance sheet is government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (p1). Transfers cross-check ok: General out 14,948 to Park in 14,948; Street out 20,661 to Debt Service in 20,661; both shown outside revenues/expenditures. Detail: only the all-funds budget schedule (p8), fund-level lines; it has budgetary actuals that differ from the fund statement (General receipts 354,515 vs 353,953; beginning 274,052 vs 273,176). Budget schedule is governmental only; budget amounts printed only for totals. Read pages 1-8 of 8 Governmental object lines (salaries, payroll taxes, professional services, utilities, repairs, miscellaneous, fuel, supplies) split by fund column on p4: General -> general government, Street -> streets/highways, Park -> culture/recreation. Detail (user 2026-10-27): per-fund lines from the fund statements' columns (p4, p6) replace the combined schedule.
